ground_truth_rules: Every BAD row requires an independent public source URL and incident timestamp.
Do not label a token BAD only because Avci or GoPlus flagged it.
GOOD controls must have comparable age/liquidity/network and no known incident in the evaluation horizon.
Never use model-generated labels as ground truth.
Prefer evidence archived before or at incident confirmation time.
acquisition_plan: Curate documented incident cases from public security incident databases and project/post-mortem reports.
Record contract address, chain, incident timestamp and source URL.
Match each BAD case with a healthy control from the same chain/age/liquidity bucket.
Run security_redteam.py; do not tune security rules on the final red-team subset.
